Name: Columbina - Custom Genshin NPC
Author: Sonix817
Description:
[center][quote][color=#d4d4d8]
Columbina Hyposelenia, the Moon Goddess, Kuutar, The Damselette ... she has many names, but now you get to meet her and show her the true meaning of the word "home"! [/color][/quote][/center]

[color=#d4d4d8][i][size=2]-- Columbina is from the game Genshin Impact by Hoyoverse and is not an original character and I don't claim her as such! [/size][/i][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][i][size=2]All the actions happen after the Nodkrai storyline, and might contain spoilers so be aware! [/size][/i][/color]


✦ ˚ . ――― [b][i]Requirements[/i][/b] ――― . ˚ ✦

[color=#d4d4d8]To install this mod you will need :[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- SMAPI[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Content Patcher[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Here is what you need to do afterwards :[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Download this mod,[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Unpack the file,[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Place it in your "mods" folder, [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Run the game using SMAPI[/color]

✦ ˚ . ――― [b][i]Features : [/i][/b]――― . ˚ ✦

[color=#d4d4d8]- [b]i18n [/b]compatibility[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- 7 heart events,[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- her own schedule,[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- her own home,[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- her own spouse patio and room,[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- unique animations,[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- over 100+ lines of dialogue (and more to come in future updates),[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- her own portraits and sprites[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]This mod is currently functional, but will be updated in the future![/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]✦ ˚ . ――― [b][i]Notes[/i][/b] ――― . ˚ ✦ [/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]After unpacking the file, you will find a README text document that contains information about her gift tastes and information about her events and schedule.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Note that this is my first ever mod and I don't have any previous experience with coding, so there may be glitches, bugs, or something may be broken. If that's the case, then I'm sorry! Please let me know and I will try to fix it when I have the time. English is also not my first language, so there may be grammar mistakes.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]If you find a mistake or an error, message me but please try to give me as much info as possible about when and how the error happened! Season, time, day, hours, it all can help me figure out how to deal with this specific issue faster.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=2][i]All the sprites, portraits and custom furniture was made by me. Do not use it for your own projects without permission.[/i][/size][/color]

[i][size=2]Huge thanks to my wonderful friends for playtesting the mod and supporting me! <3[/size][/i]
